scenario: LSER.19.8 — `count` is in the concrete partition (cold value `0`), so `count(t.v)` into a non-nullable `n: Int` slot compiles with no rescue. Pins the other direction from LSER.19.8_nullable_agg_unnarrowed: a compiler that marks EVERY aggregation nullable passes that vector and fails this one. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s `lser_19_8_cold_nullability`, which gives `count` a non-null type.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    n: Int mutable

series Reading.v:
    count sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Reading t
->
    emit Out logical k: "x" n: count(t.v)
